notes: Populated by Plan 83-02. Tier counts: 15 w3c-tier items (14 newly authored + the 83-01 seed item wcag-img-missing-alt-01), 2 derived-tier items (0 owner-tier). Poison items: 3, each failing in a different way (unchanged markup, F30-pattern filename-as-alt, empty fixedHtml with a confident explanation) -- see packages/llm/tests/eval/SOURCES.md for the full Failure/Technique citation table and selection rule. Distinct success criteria covered (8): 1.1.1, 1.3.1, 1.3.5, 1.4.8, 2.4.4, 2.4.10 (derived only), 3.3.2 (derived only), 4.1.2. Coverage gaps, stated honestly: no items for perceivable-media SCs (1.2.x captions/audio-description), keyboard/focus SCs (2.1.x, 2.4.3, 2.4.7), timing SCs (2.2.x), language SCs (3.1.x), or error-handling SCs (3.3.1/3.3.3/3.3.4) -- the W3C corpus has Failure+Technique pairs with real markup examples for several of these, but this plan's selection rule (Task 1, step 4: stop at >=15 pairs spanning >=8 SCs) was satisfied before reaching them; a future plan revising this set should treat the remaining SCs as the next slice, not an oversight. Contrast (1.4.3/1.4.6) was deliberately NOT populated: 83-RESEARCH.md's Q1 finding held on direct verification -- F24/F83 (the paired failures) describe missing colour DECLARATIONS, not the contrast-RATIO markup diff this set otherwise demonstrates, and no committed repo fixture offered a defensible derived alternative in the time this plan budgeted. Item count and tier ratio are an INPUT to Phase 85's power calculation, not a target this plan invented (CONTEXT.md open question 1).
